Privacy Policy

Effective 1 January 2026. This policy explains what information Examplegram collects about you and how we use it.

Information we collect

We collect the content you create, the messages you send, and metadata about both, including when a message was sent and who read it. We also collect information about your activity, including the posts you view and how long you view them.

  • Device identifiers, operating system and mobile network
  • Precise location, where you have granted permission
  • Your contacts, if you choose to upload your address book

How we use your information

We use your information to personalise the content you see and to select the advertisements shown to you. We infer interests from your activity, including interests you have not told us about.

Advertising

We share categories of interest with advertisers. We do not sell your name, but advertisers can reach you by the categories we place you in.

How long we keep it

We keep information for as long as we need it for the purposes above. Some information is retained after you delete your account, including records of transactions and reports made about you.

Questions?
Write to privacy@examplegram.example.
